title: Anthropic Opens Its Books as A.I. Borrowers Crack
description: Is anyone actually making money on A I? Anthropic's newly public S-1 gives the first audited answer, and it's yes. But in the same week the neoclouds that borrow to build A I got hammered, a hot economy boxed in the Fed, and NASA turned the Moon race into a race to be ready. Who can pay for growth, who can't, and what it means for your portfolio and your job search.

title: Can You Pay for Your Own Growth? SpaceX, Meta and the Cost of A.I.
description: The A I boom doesn't have a demand problem. It has a paying-for-it problem. SpaceX reveals that A I is now its biggest business, Meta's cash flow turns negative, and power-equipment stocks tumble as rates sit near five percent. Plus: why electricity is the new A I bottleneck, what Anthropic's coming I P O could reset, and where the factory jobs are.
